$comment: Sound beds for meditations. Since 29 Oct 2026 (owner) the active ones are recorded tracks from Pixabay, binaural in the original: `file.path` is a mono downmix (the same in both ears) that everybody hears, and `file.binaural_path` the original, played only to whoever answered «No» to the epilepsy question. The synthesised descriptors stay, inactive, so meditations made before still play their bed.
$safety: Binaural beats are not advised with epilepsy. The binaural file is reached only through an explicit «No» to clinical_basics.epilepsy; unanswered or «Sí» hears the mono file. The synthesised beds were never binaural.
